artist.name: ANTHH
artist.bio: Some things are easier to play than explain.
artist.about: I play guitar, sing, write songs and keep collecting the little moments that turn into music.
artist.musicIntro: Originals, covers, demos and late-night ideas.
artist.guitarsIntro: Every instrument leaves a little of itself in the music.
artist.educationDetail: Student, building a creative life alongside technology.
artist.journey: I started with the guitar, then found my way into singing, songwriting and recording. I am interested in the space where technology and music meet — making things, learning constantly and turning ideas into work people can feel.
artist.future: My goal is to grow into a professional recording artist and songwriter, work with serious musicians and producers, release original music, and build a body of work that feels unmistakably mine.
artist.producerPitch: If you are a producer, artist, composer, studio or creative team looking for a guitarist, vocalist, songwriter or a hungry collaborator, I am open to conversations, sessions and collaborations.
artist.skills: Guitar · Vocals · Songwriting · Recording · Creative Direction
